description: Finds price series by product, variety or province, in English, Spanish or Valencian (e.g. «orange», «olive oil», «wheat», «diesel zaragoza», «naranja navelina», «aceite de oliva virgen extra»). Returns each series' identifier, scope, unit, frequency, source and latest price with its date. Names and answers are in Spanish. — Busca series por producto, variedad o provincia, en español, valenciano o inglés.

ambito.description: Optional: «España» (national average), «Comunitat Valenciana», «Lonja de Salamanca» or a province (for diesel).

fuente.description: Optional: gva (Generalitat Valenciana, prices at origin), mapa (Ministry of Agriculture, national average), lonja (Lonja de Salamanca) or gasoleo (diesel).

limite.description: Optional: how many series to return, the best matches first (10 by default, at most 20).

texto.description: Product, variety or province, in English, Spanish or Valencian. Products work in English (orange, lemon, olive oil, almond, wheat, lamb, diesel…); varieties go by their Spanish names (navelina, clemenules, hojiblanca).

name: buscar_producto
title: Buscar un producto
